subject.title: fix(agents): retry same profile before timeout auth rotation

question: Should OpenClaw accept one same-model/profile retry for ordinary assistant timeouts before auth-profile rotation or model fallback?
rationale: The implementation appears mechanically sound, but it intentionally changes fallback and auth-provider timing for existing setups, which is a maintainer policy choice rather than an automated correctness decision.

options.title: Accept Bounded Timeout Retry
options.body: Merge this policy because it avoids spending auth-profile rotation on the first ordinary timeout while preserving fast failover for auth, billing, quota, and rate-limit failures.

options.title: Preserve Immediate Failover
options.body: Ask for a revision that keeps first ordinary timeouts on the existing rotation/fallback path and handles transient timeout noise through a narrower condition.

options.title: Split Session Repair First
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want the aborted-leaf replay repair to land independently before deciding the broader timeout policy.

recommendation.title: Accept Bounded Timeout Retry
recommendation.body: Merge this policy because it avoids spending auth-profile rotation on the first ordinary timeout while preserving fast failover for auth, billing, quota, and rate-limit failures.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the broadest recent agent runtime/session history among the routing candidates and is best positioned to decide the compatibility-sensitive policy tradeoff.
